manual.label: Channel Name
manual.purpose: Set the camera channel name

manual.label: Date Format
manual.purpose: Set the date format displayed by the camera OSD, there are three

manual.label: Time Format
manual.purpose: Set the time format of the camera's OSD display, there are two

manual.label: Refresh Rate
manual.purpose: Set the refresh rate of the camera, there are two options, 60Hz and 50Hz, corresponding to N and P system.

manual.label: Show Name
manual.purpose: The preview shows the camera channel name.

manual.label: Show Time
manual.purpose: The preview shows the camera time.

manual.label: Privacy Mode
manual.purpose: Privacy Mode. When Privacy Mode is enabled, there is no image in preview and playback, and the preview image is not displayed in the Settings page.

manual.label: Show Channel Name Position
manual.purpose: Set the position where the channel name is displayed by dragging the channel name on the image.

manual.label: Display Time Position
manual.purpose: Set the position of the channel time display by dragging the channel time on the image.

manual.label: Display Alarm Statistics Position
manual.purpose: Set the position of the channel alarm statistics display by dragging the channel alarm statistics on the image. This setting is only displayed when the function that supports alarm statistics display is turned on.

manual.label: Image Setting
manual.purpose: Set the camera image mode, there are 3 modes.

manual.label: Full Color Mode
manual.purpose: The camera is in full Color mode.

manual.label: Day/Night Mode
manual.purpose: The camera is in Day/Night mode.

manual.label: Smart Illumination
manual.purpose: The camera in night vision mode when the camera triggers an alarm will be linked to the warm light for fill light, the image is in color; the end of the alarm the camera back to night vision mode.

manual.label: White Light
manual.purpose: Under Full Color Mode, set the fill light effect of the camera's warm light, there are 4 modes in total.

manual.label: Automatic mode
manual.purpose: automatic mode, the camera automatically adjusts the strength of the fill light according to the ambient illumination.

manual.label: Manual
manual.purpose: Fill in the environment with a fixed brightness value.

manual.label: Schedule
manual.purpose: automatically switch on/off the warm light for fill light by setting the time schedule.

manual.label: OFF
manual.purpose: Turns off the warm light lamp.

manual.label: Sensitivity
manual.purpose: Sensitivity 0 to 3, the camera's perception of ambient light, the higher the value the more sensitive.

manual.label: Light Distance
manual.purpose: range 0 to 100, White Light is the brightness of the fill light in Manual mode, the higher the value, the higher the brightness.

manual.label: IR-CUT Mode
manual.purpose: Set the camera day/night switching mode under Day/Night Mode, there are 5 modes.

manual.label: Auto/GPIO Auto
manual.purpose: auto control switching mode, color switching black and white by image judgement, black and white conversion color by photosensitive judgement.

manual.label: Day/Color Mode
manual.purpose: Forces color mode without switching between black and white.

manual.label: Night/Black White Mode
manual.purpose: Forces black and white mode without switching color.

manual.label: Image/Image Mode
manual.purpose: Similar to Auto Mode, control the mode of color to black and black to color by image.

manual.label: Schedule/Schedule(B/W)
manual.purpose: Switch between black and white and color by schedule setting. To turn on this function, you need to set the start and end time of entering night vision.

manual.label: IR LED Control
manual.purpose: Sets the fill light effect of the camera's IR LED in night vision, with 3 modes.

manual.label: Smart IR
manual.purpose: Intelligent control of infrared lamp fill light intensity, according to the focal length, whether the screen is over the explosion of dynamic control of infrared lampsThe fill light.

manual.label: Manual
manual.purpose: Manual mode to fill in the light with the set IR lamp brightness.

manual.label: OFF
manual.purpose: No light is used for fill.

manual.label: Low/High Beam Light
manual.purpose: Manually adjust the brightness of the IR lamp (0 to 100, when set to 0 the IR lamp does not light up, and when set to 100 it is the brightest).

manual.label: Anti-Overexposure
manual.purpose: When turned on in all image modes, this function prevents overexposure of images in high-brightness environments.

manual.label: Corridor Mode
manual.purpose: The image is rotated 90 degrees clockwise. (Some models support corridor mode)

manual.label: Angle Adjustment
manual.purpose: Image rotation setting, the camera can be adjusted by this value in certain usage scenarios where the camera is inverted from the preset, e.g. designed to be used upside down, but in reality it is used in a flat position.

manual.label: Vertical Flip
manual.purpose: To make the image of the screen interact up and down.

manual.label: Horizontal Flip
manual.purpose: Mirror mode in horizontal direction so that the images of the screen interact left and right.

manual.label: Exposure Compensation
manual.purpose: Sets how the program behaves when backlit, with 4

manual.label: WDR
manual.purpose: Wide Dynamic Range in which the picture is uniformly balanced based on the setting and both light and dark areas can be clearly distinguished. (DWDR in some models)

manual.label: HLC
manual.purpose: Strong light rejection function, which makes objects in the high light area clearer in the picture according to the set HLC Level value. (Not supported by some models)

manual.label: Back Light
manual.purpose: Make the dark areas of the screen clearer according to the set BLC Level value and BLC Area.

manual.label: Disable
manual.purpose: No exposure compensation optimisation is performed on the picture frame.

manual.label: White Balance
manual.purpose: White balance setting with two modes:

manual.label: Automatic mode
manual.purpose: Adjust the white light using default parameters

manual.label: Manual
manual.purpose: Actively set the synthetic gained white light of red, green, and blue.

manual.label: Shutter
manual.purpose: Set the length of shutter exposure. (Some models have support for aperture setting; those that do not have support for aperture setting have only automatic and manual modes)

manual.label: Automatic mode
manual.purpose: The program automatically selects an appropriate exposure time and aperture value according to the currently set Time Exposure and Iris range.

manual.label: Manual
manual.purpose: Directly uses the currently set Time Exposure time and Iris aperture value.

manual.label: Shutter First
manual.purpose: Shutter First is the aperture value obtained by metering the camera with a manually defined shutter.

manual.label: Iris First
manual.purpose: Aperture priority, where the size of the aperture is defined manually and the camera's metering is used to obtain the corresponding shutter value.

manual.label: Exposure Time
manual.purpose: Set the exposure time of the camera, used in combination with Shutter. When the exposure time is long, the image will be overblown, and when the exposure time is short, the image will be dark.

manual.label: Defog Mode
manual.purpose: Defog mode. Turn it on to make the picture clearer in rainy and foggy weather. 3D Noise Reduction: Reduces noise in the image to make the picture clearer,

manual.label: Automatic mode
manual.purpose: The camera automatically selects the noise reduction effect according to the algorithm.

manual.label: OFF
manual.purpose: Noise cancellation is not switched on.

manual.label: Manual
manual.purpose: Noise reduction is performed according to the manually set noise reduction coefficient.

manual.label: Enable
manual.purpose: Enable/Disable the Video Cover function.

manual.label: Video Cover Area Setting
manual.purpose: Set the areas to be tampered in the monitoring screen. The tampered blocks are red while setting and will turn to black after they take effect. set four tampering blocks.

manual.label: Stream Mode
manual.purpose: Select the recording mode. The video stream saved in the SD card. The default is Mainstream.

manual.label: Record
manual.purpose: Check to enable recording.

manual.label: PreRecord
manual.purpose: If this option is enabled. The camera will start recording a few seconds before an alarm event occurs. This option is recommended for users whose main type of recording is based on motion detection or I/O alarms. Netbreak Event recording is also performed when the network is disconnected or the connection fails.

manual.label: Resolution
manual.purpose: This parameter indicates the resolution of the recorded image.

manual.label: Frame Rate
manual.purpose: This parameter indicates the number of frames recorded by the camera.

manual.label: Encoding Format
manual.purpose: Channel decoding type, there are H264, H265, H264+, H265+ and MJPEG. (MJPEG mode exists only in sub-stream mode)

manual.label: Video Code Level
manual.purpose: Video quality level with Bestline, Main Profile and High Profile. (Main Profile only when H265).

manual.label: Encoding Mode
manual.purpose: Select the bitrate level. For simple scenes, such as a grey wall, Constant Bit Rate (CBR) is appropriate. For more complex scenes, such as busy streets, Variable Bit Rate (VBR) is appropriate.

manual.label: Config Mode
manual.purpose: If you want to set the bitrate yourself, select "User Defined" mode. If you want to select a preset bitrate, select "Preset Mode".

manual.label: Bitrate
manual.purpose: This parameter corresponds to the data transfer speed that the camera uses to record the video. Higher bitrate videos will have better quality.

manual.label: I Frame Interval
manual.purpose: Sets the I frame interval of the camera.

manual.label: Audio
manual.purpose: Enable this option if the user wants to record audio and video at the same time and connect a microphone to the camera or use a camera with audio capabilities.

manual.label: Audio Input Type
manual.purpose: select the audio input type, there are Mic In and Line In. Mic In means the audio is input through the microphone of the device, Line In means the audio is input through the tail line of the device (supported by some models).

manual.label: Output Volume
manual.purpose: Set the volume of the output audio.

manual.label: Input Volume
manual.purpose: Set the volume of the input audio.

manual.label: Audio Code Type
manual.purpose: Set the audio decoding type, support G711A and G711U.

manual.label: Normal Interval
manual.purpose: the interval between captures in normal recording.

manual.label: Alarm Interval
manual.purpose: alarm interval, the time interval to capture images when motion detection is triggered and IO alarm is triggered.

manual.label: Auto Capture
manual.purpose: Enable/disable auto capture.

manual.purpose: The schedule is presented in table form or list form. Click on Normal, Motion or I/O on the right side to switch between different types of video schedules. Select Table form and drag or tick the corresponding time period in the table to set the corresponding time schedule. Select the List form to set the corresponding time schedule by manually adding rules and entering the start and end time periods.

manual.label: Start Time
manual.purpose: Set the schedule rule start time.

manual.label: End Time
manual.purpose: Set the end time of the schedule rule.

manual.label: Day
manual.purpose: Set the period for the schedule rule to take effect.

manual.label: Import Template
manual.purpose: Import a custom or system default schedule template.

manual.label: Save Template
manual.purpose: Save the schedule template, save the currently set schedule rule as a custom template, and import the template in other schedule setting pages.

manual.label: Format Hard Disk
manual.purpose: Select the SD card to be format, and then click Format SD Card. To start format, enter your username and password and then click OK.

manual.label: Overwrite
manual.purpose: This option to overwrite old records in the SD card when the SD card is full. If Auto is selected, the oldest data will be automatically overwritten when the SD card is full. Select OFF if you do not want to overwrite any old videos. If this function is disabled, check the status of the SD card periodically to ensure that the SD card is not full.

manual.label: Password
manual.purpose: Specifies the password of NAS (unavailable in NFS mode).

manual.label: Server IP

manual.label: Directory Name
manual.purpose: Specifies the folder where you want to store data in the NAS.

manual.label: Disk Size
manual.purpose: Specifies the size of the network HDD.

manual.label: Add NetHDD
manual.purpose: Click this option to add NAS.

manual.purpose: Enter the IP address or domain name of the user's FTP server.

manual.label: Port
manual.purpose: Enter the FTP port.

manual.purpose: Enter the user's FTP server username and password.

manual.purpose: Ticked will upload the alarm video to FTP server.

manual.purpose: Select the input alarm type.

manual.label: Schedule
manual.purpose: Set the schedule for the I/O input alarm function to take effect. Refer to

manual.purpose: Sends an email to the configured mailbox when an alert is triggered.

manual.purpose: Set whether the device will push to the RISCO server after the I/O alarm occurs.

manual.purpose: Uploads the alarm picture to the FTP server after the alarm is triggered.

manual.purpose: Uploads the alarm video to an FTP server after the alarm is triggered. Clicking on the Settings button next to it gives you the option to upload to an FTP server after an alarm is triggered.

manual.purpose: When switched on, a warm light will illuminate for warm light deterrence when an alarm is triggered.

manual.label: Warn Light
manual.purpose: When turned on, a red and blue light will be illuminated as a deterrent when an alarm is triggered.

manual.label: Siren
manual.purpose: When on, an alarm will sound for deterrence when triggered.

manual.label: Alarm Output No.
manual.purpose: Select the I/O output source for alarm linkage.

manual.label: Latch Time

If all the installed hard disks are set to Read Write mode, the NVR will save recordings to the hard disks sequentially. ⚫ To prevent important video data from being overwritten during cyclic recording, the hard drive disk can be set as Read Only type. New recordings will not be able to be saved to this read-only disk. You can still search and play recordings from this read-only disk. ⚫ A Redundant hard disk can be used to save the same recordings as what is saved to the Read Write hard disk(s). When a redundant disk is set, the system can save recordings in parallel to both the Read Write hard disk and the redundant hard disk in case of hard disk failure.

manual.label: Channels
manual.purpose: Channel selection, you can select the statistical channel.

events.Face Detection: Detects faces and produces face snapshots. It does not identify a person until a recognition database/model is also used.
events.Pedestrian and Vehicle: Detects/captures supported people and vehicle classes, with target-size and capture controls.
events.Multi-Target-Type Recognition: Processes multiple supported target classes and attributes. Availability and combinations are model/resource dependent.
events.License Plate: Detects/reads vehicle registration plates; capture scene, plate size and matching groups determine usable results.
events.Line Crossing: Triggers when an eligible target crosses a drawn line in the selected direction.
events.Intrusion: Triggers when a target enters/remains in the configured region, subject to any dwell threshold.
events.Enter Region: Triggers when an eligible target moves into a drawn region.
events.Exit Region: Triggers when an eligible target leaves a drawn region.
events.Object Detection: Detects abandoned or missing objects according to the selected rule type and region.
events.Fire & Smoke Detection: Optical analytic for selected flame/smoke classes. This is separate from thermal Fire Detection.
events.Fire Detection: Thermal fire/hot-spot analytic exposed on the thermal channel. Exact threshold/calibration behavior is not documented in the supplied generic manuals.
events.Temperature Measurement: Measures temperatures for configured spots/regions and can link temperature conditions to alarms on supported thermal hardware.
events.Cross Counting: Counts eligible targets crossing a line, separated by direction, and can trigger a count threshold alarm.
events.Heat Map: Summarizes activity distribution over space/time; the statistical heat map is not a radiometric temperature map.
events.Queue Length: Monitors a queue region for excessive target count or waiting/staying time.
events.Crowd Density: Monitors the number/density of targets within a region and alarms at a configured threshold.
events.Rare Sound: Classifies supported unusual sounds such as baby crying, dog barking, or gunshot on models with suitable audio.
events.Motion Detection: Detects motion in the configured area. AI Motion can restrict eligible motion to supported target classes.
events.Sound Detection: Detects audio conditions using its sensitivity/threshold controls; separate from Rare Sound classification.
events.Video Tampering: Detects an abnormal/obscured camera image, for example lens covering, according to sensitivity.
events.Video Loss: Generates an NVR event when a camera/video signal is lost.
events.Fall Detection: Analytic intended to identify a person falling. Its settings page was inspected on the 8MP fixed bullet: Long Distance Mode, Loitering Duration(s) (0–10), target-size limits, sensitivity, Bounding Box, Result Box and Detection Area. Accuracy, dependencies and alarm behavior were not tested. This purpose is inferred from the label.

models.name: 5MP varifocal bullet
models.coverage: Direct camera remote configuration: display, expanded image, recording/main/sub/audio, capture, privacy mask, event panes, plate-management availability, network, platform, system and maintenance menus. Disabled controls and configuration-changing operations were not exercised.

models.name: 8MP fixed bullet
models.coverage: Direct camera remote configuration: display, expanded image, recording/main/sub/third/audio, capture, privacy mask, event inventory/linkage and network menus. The remaining system, platform, maintenance, storage, alarm, statistics, cloud/email/security, user and information menus were captured after access was renewed. Fall Detection, multi-target, flame/smoke and license-plate Settings panes were inspected.

models.name: 5MP dome
models.coverage: Direct remote configuration inspected after access renewal: expanded image, recording/main/sub/audio, capture/mask, event settings, license-plate availability, storage, deterrence/siren, network/platform, system, users, maintenance and information pages. The inspected common controls match the 5MP bullet closely.

findings.purpose: Analytic intended to identify a person falling. Its settings page was inspected on the 8MP fixed bullet: Long Distance Mode, Loitering Duration(s) (0–10), target-size limits, sensitivity, Bounding Box, Result Box and Detection Area. Accuracy, dependencies and alarm behavior were not tested. This purpose is inferred from the label.
findings.evidence: Detailed Settings page inspected. Not present in the captured 5MP bullet or dome event menus; no detector was enabled or tested.

findings.purpose: An additional analytic result-display overlay switch observed on the 8MP camera. It is separate from Bounding Box. The supplied manuals do not establish its exact visual contents or whether it is embedded in every output stream; behavior was not tested.
findings.evidence: Observed under Event Settings; separate switch from Bounding Box. Exact effect needs confirmation.

findings.purpose: A Fall Detection mode intended for more distant subjects, inferred from its label. The 8MP exposes it as a switch; the exact detection-distance range and algorithm change are not explained by the supplied manuals and were not tested.
findings.evidence: Observed in the Fall Detection Settings pane after maintenance access renewal; not toggled.

findings.purpose: Manages reference faces for recognition, distinct from face detection/capture. The 8MP exposes this additional List Management tab. The current page reports unavailable in the current state; database fields and recognition behavior were not exercised.
findings.evidence: Observed tab and unavailable-state message. The 5MP dome and bullet expose only License Plate Management in this menu.

findings.purpose: The inspected dome exposes the same common image controls (including Corridor Mode), two encoded video streams, input/output audio volumes, Deterrence, Siren and plate-related controls as the inspected 5MP bullet. No additional dome-only setting label was established in this navigation pass.
findings.evidence: Direct comparison of RVCM32A330RA and RVCM52A350RA, both VC31.35.1.3.6-261114. Physical optics and hidden mode-dependent controls were not exercised.

findings.purpose: Rotates the image for narrow vertical scenes such as corridors. It is separate from horizontal/vertical flip and angle adjustment. The camera manual describes a 90-degree clockwise corridor mode (p. 34).
findings.evidence: Observed switch in expanded Image Settings on both models; already described in the manual library, newly inventoried for these cameras.

findings.purpose: Minimum time an eligible target must remain in an intrusion region before the dwell/loitering condition triggers. The observed 5MP Intrusion page uses seconds.
findings.evidence: Observed in Intrusion settings. The concept already exists in the manual library; the firmware-specific label was added.

findings.purpose: The inspected 5MP menu exposes Mainstream and Substream; the 8MP also exposes Thirdstream. Each stream has separate encoding settings. Do not apply a three-stream assumption to the 5MP model.
findings.evidence: Observed Video Parameters tabs. Stream profile limits and permitted resolutions/codecs were not exhaustively enumerated.

findings.purpose: The 5MP exposes Image Setting/Smart Illumination and White Light controls plus Deterrence and Siren menus. The 8MP image page exposes IR-CUT Mode, IR-CUT Sensitivity, IR LED Control and Low Beam Light; its captured main menu has no Deterrence or Siren page.
findings.evidence: Observed menu/control difference at the current configuration. Mode-dependent alternatives were not revealed by changing settings.

findings.purpose: The 5MP Audio page exposes Output Volume, Input Volume and Audio Encoding. The 8MP Audio page exposes Input Volume, Audio Encoding and Sampling Rate; Output Volume was absent from that pane.
findings.evidence: Observed controls; absence from this pane is not an independently verified hardware specification.

findings.purpose: Plate detection/capture and list-based recognition are separate functions. The 5MP detection page exposes Select Mode, Snap Mode, Snapshot Interval, plate-type target, Detection Mode, LPD Enhance and Capture Vehicle Image. Its License Plate Management page reports that the feature is unavailable in the current state.
findings.evidence: Settings panes inspected on both bullets and dome. The 8MP adds Face Database Management; its face/plate management pages and the 5MP plate-management pages report unavailable in the current state. No detector was enabled to expose hidden options.

findings.purpose: These analytic entries are visible on the inspected 8MP firmware. The captured 5MP bullet menu does not list them. Multi-target analytics and optical flame/smoke detection are separate from thermal thermometry.
findings.evidence: Settings panes captured on 8MP after access renewal. Resource compatibility and event behavior were not tested.

findings.purpose: Neither captured direct-camera main menu exposes I/O or Combined Alarm. Do not carry over the thermal camera I/O controls to these cameras, or infer that an NVR alarm input is a camera terminal.
findings.evidence: Observed menu absence on these models/firmware; confirm physical hardware support from each model specification.

model_comparison.remaining: The interrupted comparison resumed after maintenance access was renewed. The remaining 8MP menus and the 5MP dome were inspected. Conditional options requiring mode changes, disabled database editors, and actual event/output behavior remain untested; Result Box and Long Distance Mode effects require confirmation. No settings were saved, detectors enabled, or Add controls used during this comparison.
